query: UPDATE provider_credentials SET name = $3, ciphertext = $4, nonce = $5, wrapped_key = $6, key_id = $7, last4 = $8, auth_method = $9, expires_at = $10, account_label = $11, project = $12, location = $13, account_id = $14, gateway_id = $15, auth_error = NULL, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE org_id = $1 AND id = $2
